changelog.description: Release notes for this version (App Store translation or forge release body), truncated to 8 KiB server-side; null when the source provides none.

recordedSha.description: SHA-256 recorded on the source binding from a previous successful external install of this version (trust-on-first-use); null when none is recorded, e.g. App Store versions or a version never installed from this binding.

get.summary: Lists installed apps for the admin cards, including each app's last-known-good version record (admin-only)

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

200.description: Installed apps enriched with card metadata, installed version, and last-known-good record

installedVersion.description: Live installed version of the app (null when unknown)

lkg.description: Last-known-good version record — the last version that finalized cleanly through App Versions; null when none is recorded yet. See "Last-known-good version record".

403.description: Current user is not an admin

get.summary: Lists available versions for an app from its bound (or overridden) source, each with a nullable changelog

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: App id to list versions for

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Explicit source override (bypasses the sticky binding for this fetch)

200.description: Version listing for the app, newest-first

403.description: Current user is not an admin

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: Filter entries to a single app id

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, default 50, hard cap 200

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Pagination offset

403.description: Current user is not an admin

get.summary: Lists all pins joined with the live installed version and drift status (admin-only)

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

200.description: Every pin, joined with the live installed version and drift status

403.description: Current user is not an admin

put.summary: Pins an app to its currently installed version (admin-only, password-confirmed)

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Optional — must equal the installed version if given

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: Optional free-text reason recorded on the pin

400.description: App is not installed, or a version other than the installed one was requested

403.description: Current user is not an admin

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass
